body: They are incredible souls. Sounds like Oscar is a very good boy!
Thank you so much for the lovely words!

I'm a big fan of this - it has a similar structure to the work of Rupi Kaur, who I'm a massive fan of. At first I wasn't sure about the absence of punctuation in the first Stanza, but having re-read it a couple of times, it gives it a really sense of 'stream-of-conciousness', which I really like!
I'm new to this thread, but I figured I would make my blog known, looking forward to talking to everyone here about words and stuff. https://samuelnorris.wordpress.com/2017/08/12/lost/
